synthesis.paragraph: Three of today's papers carry the tag "Urban Transport and Accessibility," examining key determinants of urban bus service quality in Dhaka, assessing the effectiveness of interventions to increase cycling, and analyzing how passengers with non-visible disabilities navigate public transport in Hong Kong. Outside of this group, one paper conceptualizes post-2009 Athens through the lens of urban extractivism to show how the Greek sovereign debt crisis institutionalized extractive governance. Another study evaluates the 2019 European Capitals of Culture programmes in Matera and Plovdiv to analyze how these large-scale cultural events affect urban social cohesion. Finally, a third paper analyzes the spatial and temporal links between foodification, touristification, and short-term rentals in a historical fish market area in Catania, Italy.
